source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 借剑一观，剑断情伤
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC10 after EP02 SC09 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the white-clothed woman asking to inspect Wufeng, the broken sword floating into her hand, rust falling away under moonlight, and her emotional reaction to the old Shennong/Kongsang connection.
title: 借剑一观，剑断情伤

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC09 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC09 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 白衣女子道：“不知公子可否将此剑借我一观么？”
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 白衣女子请拓拔野借断剑一观。拓拔野恭敬地倒转剑锋递上，断剑却在她伸手间如受无形牵引般缓缓飞到她掌中。女子轻抖手腕，剑上铁锈簌簌落下，断剑在月光下泛出青白光芒，并显露出旧日铭痕。她凝视剑身许久，忽然落下一滴泪，低声道出“人有情，剑无锋”的伤感。拓拔野见她睹剑伤情，惊讶而不敢打扰。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 随后白衣女子解释无锋剑原是木族神器，剑虽断但缘分未断，并将断剑送回拓拔野腰间，嘱咐他收好。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, relic bundle, green bamboo flute, and broken Wufeng at the right waist.
Wufeng is a broken plain blue-grey iron sword; if the story needs old name marks, render them only as indistinct glowing engraved strokes, never readable Chinese characters.
White-clothed woman remains adult, elegant, distant, water/rain-associated, fully clothed, respectful, and emotionally restrained until the tear beat.
Avoid sexualized framing, hand/body fetish framing, or teen-romance coding. The beat is mythic recognition and old grief.
Setting remains moonlit Tianhu bamboo pavilion, lake reflection, bamboo shadows, mist, and faint incense smoke.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, speech bubbles, English words, signs, plaques, UI, or clear inscriptions.
localization_rules: All planning text and eventual editing dialogue should be Chinese unless a technical field requires English.
Storyboard prompts may include intended Chinese dialogue as off-screen planning context, but must request no rendered subtitles or readable text.
I2V prompts must use silent visual generation: no synthesized speech, no lip-sync dialogue, no flute/xiao audio, no captions, no subtitles, no readable signs, no English words.
Chinese dialogue, narration, sound design, and subtitles should be added later in editing.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Use stable handover, sword-floating, rust-falling, tear, and reaction beats. Avoid lip-sync, fast gestures, or readable inscription closeups.

suggested_shots.title: 恭敬递剑
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Tuobaye respectfully reverses the broken Wufeng and offers it toward the white-clothed woman, keeping the edge away from her.

suggested_shots.title: 断剑凌空入掌
suggested_shots.visual_focus: The broken sword floats through moonlit mist toward the woman hand, moved by invisible force; keep framing respectful and avoid hand fetish emphasis.

suggested_shots.title: 锈落白芒
suggested_shots.visual_focus: The woman holds the broken Wufeng; rust flakes fall away and the blade glows pale blue-white under moonlight, with only indistinct non-readable engraved strokes.

suggested_shots.title: 剑断情伤
suggested_shots.visual_focus: The white-clothed woman silently sheds one tear over the glowing broken sword while Tuobaye watches anxiously from a respectful distance.
